Bessent Warns China Could Threaten US AI Lead
Speaking during a Breitbart News "State of the Economy" policy discussion, Bessent said maintaining America’s AI advantage is critical to national security and the economy.
"Beating China — there is no day after tomorrow if China wins at this," Bessent said, adding, "If they were to pull ahead of us on AI, then nothing else matters."
Bessent credited America’s technology ecosystem, including its chip industry and access to capital, for helping the U.S. establish its current lead.
